label: digit 0 input early in the original phase
explanation: Fires only when the input token is the digit 0, and almost entirely during the original (pre-<DEL>) phase. All activation mass sits on in_tok==0. Activation is largest at the earliest positions (t=0 carries 36% of mass) and drops off with position: rare at t=5, essentially zero at t>=6. The strongest activations come after a few letter tokens at t=3, e.g. c e e [0]. Second and later occurrences of 0 in the same sequence fire more weakly. It does not fire at the delimiter step, and it barely fires in the copy phase (0.6% of mass, only at recall_idx 1, when 0 is re-fed as input). It never fires on letters or on the digits 1-3. Dev: P=0.85, R=0.95, F1=0.90, mass recall 0.98.

issues: Main claims check out on test. The predicate scores P 0.855, R 0.948, F1 0.899, mass recall 0.979. Every bit of activation mass is on in_tok==0. Delimiter: 0 active steps. Copy phase holds 0.6% of mass and fires only at recall_idx 1. Firing stops by t=6 (143 active steps at t=6, 1 at t=8). Share of mass: t=0 has 0.359; t=5 has 0.017 on dev.

Precision falls with absolute position (L does not matter). For input 0 in the original phase: t=0 1.00, t=2 0.84, t=3 0.80, t=4 0.63, t=5 0.24. It is flat across L=5..9 at each t. So most false positives come from 0s at t=2..4 that do not fire. The explanation's 'drops off with position' is right but plays down how often a 0 at t=4 stays silent (37%).

The previous token modulates the feature, and the explanation does not mention this. For 0 at t=1..4, precision by prev_tok: 'l' 0.27, 'p' 0.62, '2' 0.58, 'q' 0.66, 'b' 0.68, against 'e' 0.99, 't' 0.97, 'y' 0.96, 'c' 0.95. A preceding 'l' is a systematic suppressor. Even so, excluding it only lifts test F1 from 0.899 to 0.904, so it is a secondary effect, not a missing class.
'Second and later occurrences fire more weakly' holds, but only weakly. in_first==0 has precision 0.83 against 0.857 for first occurrences. Its mass share (0.045) is below its count share (0.058).
Earlier digits in the prefix lower the hit rate a little: precision 0.73 with a digit in the previous 4 tokens, 0.89 without. The effect is graded, not a separate class.
